title: MPK Qwen3 0.6B Snapshot-Pointer Patch Memcheck
command: cd tmp/baselines/mirage-mpk && apply local RuntimeConfig::paged_kv_indices_snapshot pointer patch, then HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck --target-processes all python demo/qwen3/demo.py --model Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --max-new-tokens 1 --max-seq-length 128 --max-num-batched-requests 1 --max-num-batched-tokens 1 --ignore-eos --use-mirage --output-dir ../../cuda-backend/paper-baselines/mpk/patched-snapshot-pointer/token1_memcheck/build --save-tokens ../../cuda-backend/paper-baselines/mpk/patched-snapshot-pointer/token1_memcheck/tokens.json
observation: The snapshot pointer patch removes the previous invalid global write from compute-sanitizer output: the patched memcheck log has no invalid global access records and only reports the existing cudaDeviceSetLimit API error before the demo later fails while decoding generated token IDs.
blocker: The snapshot pointer patch is still local to the ignored MPK clone and the sanitized run remains partial because the demo raises OverflowError at demo.py:846 during tokenizer.decode under compute-sanitizer; import paper-grade MPK rows only after the patch is reproducible and the sanitized run reaches token export.
